description: This header file defines utility functions, variables, macros, and includes necessary headers for server-side testing in cURL's Linux implementation. It includes functions for data conversion, logging, process management, signal handling, and socket operations, tailored for cross-platform compatibility.

methods.name: data_to_hex
methods.description: Converts binary data to a hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: logmsg
methods.description: Logs a formatted message, similar to printf.

methods.name: timediff
methods.description: Calculates the difference in milliseconds between two timeval structures.

methods.name: test2fopen
methods.description: Opens a test case file based on the test number and log directory.

methods.name: wait_ms
methods.description: Pauses execution for a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: our_getpid
methods.description: Returns the process ID, with platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: write_pidfile
methods.description: Writes the current process ID to a specified file.

methods.name: write_portfile
methods.description: Writes a network port number to a specified file.

methods.name: set_advisor_read_lock
methods.description: Sets a read lock on a specified file.

methods.name: clear_advisor_read_lock
methods.description: Clears the read lock on a specified file.

methods.name: install_signal_handlers
methods.description: Installs signal handlers for process signals.

methods.name: bind_unix_socket
methods.description: Binds a UNIX domain socket to a given path.
